title: FE Hino Heavy Duty Polished Custom Aluminium Bullbar #9
description: Hino FE 4 post hi-tensile polished aluminium heavy duty Bullbar with heavy duty box style uprights. One piece heavy duty 76mm diam. cross pipes. Contoured main channel with heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate. Custom built removable headlight protectors. Combination indicator repeater and daylight running lights in outer box uprights. Provision for truck mounted Radar sensor. Dangerous Goods sign mounted on mounting plate. Custom driving light mounts to customer specification.
